title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 13 in F-sharp major

character.text: No genre label; a motivic fugue whose second long section freely inverts the first

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (5 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every beat. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 17–19). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 30–31).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–14) in part, in the same voices, a step higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 33–34).

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of the subject (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–14), with soprano and alto exchanged, a fifth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every beat.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 17–19) in part, in the same voices, a third lower. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
